messages.content: "Can you calculate the electric field strength at a distance of 0.5 meters from a point charge of 2 Coulombs located in a vacuum? Then, can you also calculate the electric field strength at a distance of 1 meter and 2 meters from the same point charge? Lastly, can you calculate the electric field strength at a distance of 1 meter from the same point charge but this time located in air?"

function.name: calculate_electric_field_strength
function.description: Calculate the electric field strength at a certain distance from a point charge. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance from the charge in meters. This is a float type value.

medium.description: The medium in which the charge and the point of calculation is located. Default is 'vacuum'.

In vacuum, k = 8.9875517873681764e9 N·m²/C². In air, k is slightly less: k_air = k / ε_r where ε_r ~ 1.0006. So k_air ≈ 8.9875517873681764e9 / 1.0006 ≈ 8.983... But we can approximate.
